scenario.result: Real 510.5: Lightning's First Strike deals its 3 damage in the FIRST combat-damage sub-step, real-lethally destroying the 3-toughness blocker (704.5g) BEFORE the regular sub-step ever runs — the blocker deals zero damage back (no dealDamage entry from it at all), so Lightning survives fully undamaged.
